nodes.label: Compliance, Waivers, Enforcement & Sanctions
nodes.summary: Compliance framework including breach self-reporting, waiver applications, HKEX disciplinary powers, SFC enforcement, cooling-off periods, director unsuitability, and sanctions.

nodes.label: Breach Self-Reporting
nodes.summary: Listed companies must self-report breaches of Listing Rules to the Exchange. Self-reporting is a mitigating factor in disciplinary proceedings.

nodes.label: Waiver Applications
nodes.summary: The Exchange may grant waivers from strict Listing Rule compliance in appropriate circumstances. Waivers are published on the HKEX website.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2.04 — Waivers
nodes.summary: The Exchange may waive or modify any Listing Rule in specific circumstances.

nodes.label: HKEX Disciplinary Powers
nodes.summary: HKEX has contractual disciplinary powers under the Listing Rules, including the Listing Committee and Listing Review Committee, to impose sanctions on issuers and directors for Rule breaches.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.02 — Exchange Disciplinary Powers
nodes.summary: Seed anchor for the Exchange's disciplinary jurisdiction and powers under Chapter 2A. Official source verification required.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.09 — Sanctions
nodes.summary: Sanctions available include public censure, fines (up to HK$30 million), suspension, cancellation of listing, and director unsuitability statements.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.10 — Disciplinary Sanctions
nodes.summary: Seed anchor for sanctions and remedial directions under the Listing Rules. Official source verification required.

nodes.label: HKEX Disciplinary Action — Hontex
nodes.summary: Seed disciplinary reference for future official-source checking. Do not treat as verified authority.

nodes.label: HKEX Disciplinary Action — HCIG
nodes.summary: Seed disciplinary reference for future official-source checking. Do not treat as verified authority.

nodes.label: SFC Enforcement
nodes.summary: The SFC has broad investigatory and enforcement powers under the SFO, including the power to investigate, discipline licensed persons, suspend trading, and prosecute market misconduct.

nodes.label: SFO s.179 — SFC Investigatory Powers
nodes.summary: The SFC may require production of documents, attend for examination, and enter premises to investigate suspected breaches.

nodes.label: SFO s.182 — SFC Investigation Powers
nodes.summary: Seed statutory anchor for SFC investigation powers. Official source verification required.

nodes.label: SFO s.194 — Disciplinary Powers
nodes.summary: Seed statutory anchor for SFC disciplinary powers over regulated persons. Official source verification required.

nodes.label: SFO s.195 — Disciplinary Powers
nodes.summary: Seed statutory anchor for SFC disciplinary powers over registered institutions. Official source verification required.

nodes.label: Cooling-Off / Director Unsuitability
nodes.summary: Directors found unsuitable by the Exchange may be subject to cooling-off periods before they can serve as directors of listed companies.

nodes.label: Sanctions and Remedial Steps
nodes.summary: Sanctions include public censure, fines, suspension, cancellation of listing, and director disqualification. Remedial steps may be required to address breaches.

nodes.label: SFO s.285 — MMT Sanctions
nodes.summary: Sanctions include disqualification (up to 5 years), disgorgement of profits, fines (up to 3x profit), and cold shoulder orders.

nodes.label: Detect Potential Breach
nodes.summary: Step 1: Identify a possible Listing Rule, disclosure, or regulatory breach.

nodes.label: Investigation and Information Request
nodes.summary: Step 2: Exchange or SFC requests information and investigates the alleged breach.

nodes.label: Disciplinary Referral
nodes.summary: Step 3: Refer matter to the relevant disciplinary or enforcement body where appropriate.

nodes.label: Sanction and Remediation
nodes.summary: Step 4: Impose sanctions, remedial directions, or follow-up compliance steps.

nodes.label: Identify Breach
nodes.summary: Step 1: Identify and triage a possible breach or non-compliance event.

nodes.label: Self-Report or Seek Waiver
nodes.summary: Step 2: Decide whether to self-report, seek a waiver, or make remedial disclosure.

nodes.label: Remedial Follow-Up
nodes.summary: Step 3: Implement remedial steps and maintain an audit trail for review.
